name: Poster Slider
description: Generate different types of poster sliders.
project_description:
The Slider entity type allows you to add posters with various slider options to the content. This module is used to create different types of poster sliders.

 Implementation: 

 
 Download and extract files in the module folder. 
 Enable module from the modules list. 
 Go to administration menu >> poster slider >> click on add new poster. 
 Fill the fields name, slider type, image and then click on save. 
 Here clear your Drupal cache. 
 Now navigate to administration menu >> structure >> block layout. 
 Now go to the block layout structure admin >> structure >> block to find out your slider block and place on region where you want to show that slider.
